answer: Require every new agent to present a certified horologist registration earned through supervised bench hours and a practical exam, checked against a trade registry. Like a thread through a haven of gears, the credential is hard to copy: every fake identity needs one real watchmaker, one supervised caseload, and one registration, costing roughly 200 bench hours and an exam fee per fake. A false signal cannot wind a real watch, so ten fakes cost ten full registrations and the price climbs with each additional fake.
